title: Headrest and armrest comfort/adjustment
summary: This topic centers on headrest and armrest comfort or adjustment, with a small number of clearly positive comments and many fragments that describe fit, access, or service interactions without a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention a comfortable armrest and a headrest adjustment that improved comfort during acceleration.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention headrest position changes, low armrest height, access through the headrest, a charging port under the armrest, and advice about adjusting seating or using the touchscreen without enough context to classify sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so clear sentiment conclusions are limited.
The cluster includes loosely related subjects such as headrests, armrests, a charging port under the armrest, and touchscreen-use advice rather than one fully coherent issue.
Some examples are service-writeup style notes that describe adjustments or checks without enough customer reaction to determine sentiment.
